statement: Given explicit pinned development inputs for an oci_container image or prebuilt wasm_component payload, one local build owner publishes an atomic OCI image-layout directory and immutable deterministic receipt whose descriptor graph binds the exact bytes; identical inputs reproduce the same content graph, and InstallableServiceArtifactResolver accepts the exact local layout for a matching external manifest while tampered or partial graphs fail closed, without registry, catalog, control-transport, reconciler, or runtime activation.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Start from terminal S1/S2 commit d2a74764. The immutable receipt owns layoutPath, runtimeKind, topManifestDescriptor (digest/mediaType/sizeBytes), payloadDescriptors, totalPayloadBytes, explicit platform, sourceDateEpoch, and buildInputFingerprint. S5a only provides source/template inputs and S5c later materializes and submits the final external manifest.

One service-layer build owner creates both oci_container and prebuilt wasm_component layouts. Its output must engage InstallableServiceArtifactResolver through LOCAL_OCI_LAYOUT in proof; no parallel resolver, packaging path, or artifact identity owner is permitted.

Publish oci-layout 1.0.0, schemaVersion 2 index.json with exactly one top image-manifest descriptor, and all referenced config/layer blobs at their sha256 digest paths with exact media type and size. Validate the whole graph before atomic publication.

Canonical JSON bytes, explicit platform and sourceDateEpoch, a deterministic build-input fingerprint, digest-addressed final layout paths, immutable receipts, and atomic sibling-directory publication make identical inputs idempotent. Failure or malformed exporter output leaves no published partial layout.

Container builds route through an injected Buildx adapter whose production path uses docker buildx build with an OCI directory output, explicit platform/SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, OCI media types, timestamp rewrite, and disabled provenance. Deterministic core closure uses an injected in-process exporter and does not require live Docker.

WASM input is a prebuilt binary payload only, published as exactly one application/wasm layer with a deterministic empty OCI config. Do not reuse or describe the legacy JavaScript envelope as genuine WASM, and make no component-validation or runtime-activation claim.

Scope is the JavaScript service API/build owner, Buildx adapter, focused tests, deterministic scenario runner, and architecture truth. Do not mutate CLI, catalog/SQL, reconciler, control transport, capability claims, or runtime activation.

Focused proof attacks missing and tampered blobs, size/digest/media mismatches, invalid or multi-entry indexes, incorrect WASM layer cardinality, unsafe output roots, exporter failure, determinism, idempotency, receipt immutability, and resolver acceptance.

New src files remain at or below 800 lines and new test files at or below 1500. Record runtime-grammar, literal, file-size, focused lint/test/scenario gates, three consecutive green measurements, and independent exact-patch plus aggregate red-on-revert verifier approval before checkpoint and terminal handoff.
